subject: MHS Safety, Security and School Climate Report
overview: The committee reviewed a consultant’s report regarding the culture and operations of Medford High School following recent safety incidents. Members discussed administrative restructuring, the establishment of new leadership committees, and strategies for improving school-wide behavioral norms.

items.title: Report Presentation and Vision
items.summary: Consultant Michael Welch summarized his report on high school operations, recommending a unified vocational and comprehensive school vision supported by a single master schedule.

items.title: Administrative Mentoring and Stability
items.summary: The committee discussed the necessity of providing external coaching and professional mentoring for the incoming principal and new administrative team to ensure long-term stability.

items.title: Motion for Progress Updates
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting a progress report by mid-August regarding the formation of recommended leadership committees for safety, student behavior, and diversity.

items.title: Motion for Executive Session
items.summary: Approved a motion to invite the consultant to an executive session to provide counsel on impact bargaining related to teacher duty requirements.

items.title: Disciplinary and Instructional Support
items.summary: Members discussed streamlining the student disciplinary referral process and utilizing curriculum directors to provide more direct support for teacher classroom management.

items.title: Staffing and Budgetary Impact
items.summary: The Superintendent updated the committee on administrative recruitment and the potential for repurposing existing staff to fill recommended dean positions.
